court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent were married in 2012. They have a 7-year-old child. The respondent filed for divorce, but the petitioner is unemployed and cannot afford to contest the case.

legal_principles.principle: The interest of the minor child is of paramount importance and the Courts are bound to protect the interest of the minor children at all circumstances.
legal_principles.held: This Court is of the considered opinion that the disputes are no way connected with the maintenance of a minor child. Dispute between the husband and wife is to be resolved in the manner known to law or they can go for Conciliation for reunion or otherwise.

legal_principles.principle: Remedy of maintenance is a social justice as envisaged under the Constitution to prevent the child from falling into destitution or vagrancy.
legal_principles.held: Remedy of maintenance is a social justice as envisaged under the Constitution to prevent the child from falling into destitution or vagrancy.

legal_principles.principle: Courts are bound to consider the grant of interim maintenance even in the absence of application from the mother till such time the final maintenance is to be determined after adjudication.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, even in the absence of application seeking maintenance, the Courts are bound to consider the grant of interim maintenance whenever a child is residing with the mother, who is not employed. Even in case, the mother is employed, the father has to share the maintenance in respect of the minor.

legal_principles.principle: Courts are directed to look into the issues and consider for grant of interim maintenance to protect the livelihood of the children residing with the unemployed mother.
legal_principles.held: In all such cases, the Courts are directed to look into the issues and consider for grant of interim maintenance to protect the livelihood of the children residing with the unemployed mother.

outcome.final_order: The petition for transfer was allowed, and the HMOP No.13 of 2021 was transferred from the Subordinate Court, Kangayam to the Family Court, Karur.

use_for_drafting: assisting with transfer of cases between courts
